metrics.metric: stages only in the regional plan
stages only in the full plan
metrics.note: a regional rescan runs GEOMETRIC_CLEANUP without semantic labels
the first stages never see the rest of the venue's frames

metrics.value: POIs whose latest position lies inside the region polygon (superseded), plus new detections
whole floor when the region touches the ACTIVE graph, otherwise none
metrics.note: Recast re-bakes the full floor; no per-tile partial bake
both a full and a regional run need SPLAT_RECONSTRUCTION, which needs a CUDA GPU; this host has none
metrics.command: SELECT r.id, s.stage, extract(epoch FROM s.finished_at - s.started_at) FROM pipeline_stage_run s JOIN pipeline_run r ON r.id = s.run_id WHERE r.id IN ('<full run>', '<regional run>')

metrics.note: both a full and a regional run need SPLAT_RECONSTRUCTION, which needs a CUDA GPU; this host has none
metrics.command: SELECT s.run_id, count(*) FROM processing_artifact a JOIN pipeline_stage_run s ON s.id = a.stage_run_id WHERE s.run_id IN ('<full run>', '<regional run>') GROUP BY 1
